subject: Covert cross from qtl to qtl2

messages.author: 04e62c3b36bb17bf
messages.subject: Covert cross from qtl to qtl2
parts:
Hi Karl - there are a number of useful functions in qtl2 that I am hoping to apply to my R/qtl cross objects (e.g. calc_kinship).
Is it possible to coerce a qtl cross object into qtl2 format directly? I would prefer to avoid writing / reading all of the necessary files if possible.
Thanks.
John

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Covert cross from qtl to qtl2
parts:
the qtl2geno package has a function convert2cross2()

https://github.com/rqtl/qtl2geno/blob/master/R/convert2cross2.R

karl
